name: fgrep
summary: Search for fixed strings without regular expressions.
description: Historical name for grep -F; treats patterns as literal strings. Prefer grep -F in new scripts.

options.description: Prefix matching lines with line numbers.

examples.explanation: Searches the exact phrase without regex interpretation.

examples.title: Match regex punctuation literally
